sources.title: Nomikos | AI-assisted manuscript annotation and HTR
sources.snippet: Nomikos is the annotation platform behind the NOMOS project: a hosted editor, open HTR models on Hugging Face, and an optional command-line inference agent you install with uv tool install nomikos-inference. Pair it once with nomikos pair, then leave nomikos run working through the queue. New models arrive as a new release of the package.
